title: Groom Club Monthly Membership Terms — New-Member Courtesy on Late-Cancellation Charges
content:
**New-member courtesy (Groom Club Monthly, Tailwise Grooming Salon).** The new-member courtesy on the club late-cancellation charge follows the calendar days from the club's purchase date to today: fewer than 90 days keeps 0.5 of the charge, 90 to fewer than 180 days keeps 0.75 of it, and 180 days or more keeps all of it.

The courtesy share multiplies the club late-cancellation charge. The purchase date is the date the club was joined, shown on the club record; "today" is the day the charge is worked out.

| Calendar days from joining to today | Share of the charge kept |
|---|---|
| 0 to 89 | 0.5 |
| 90 to 179 | 0.75 |
| 180 or more | all |

**Either side of each line (hypothetical club joined 1 January of a non-leap year)**

| Today | Days since joining | Share kept |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March | 89 | 0.5 |
| 1 April | 90 | 0.75 |
| 29 June | 179 | 0.75 |
| 30 June | 180 | all |
